main.description: A real place events happen, one per place, identified by its space's key: two venues can share a name. Written only by the Local Network root account, into the venue's space. Adding a venue doesn't make anyone its owner: that takes a confirmed claim.

address.description: Its street address, or at least its city and country.

geo.description: Its coordinates, or its city's until someone adds the place's own.

fsq.description: The place in the Foursquare Open Source Places dataset. No two venues have the same one.

approval.description: open (Anyone can list): events naming it show at once, waiting for the venue until an owner confirms them. approval (Venue approves): they show only once confirmed.
